mapper.select: SELECT DATE(c.create_time) label, NULL provider, c.model label, c.provider, COUNT(*) calls, SUM(CASE WHEN c.usage_known THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) known_calls, COUNT(c.estimated_cost_cny) priced_calls, SUM(c.estimated_cost_cny) cost_cny, SUM(c.input_tokens) input_tokens, SUM(c.output_tokens) output_tokens, SUM(c.cached_tokens) cached_tokens, SUM(c.cache_write_tokens) cache_write_tokens FROM t_agent_model_call c JOIN t_agent_run r ON r.id=c.run_id WHERE c.del_flag=0 AND r.del_flag=0 AND r.agent_id > 0 AND c.create_time <= #{end} AND c.create_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE(c.create_time) ORDER BY DATE(c.create_time) GROUP BY c.model, c.provider ORDER BY SUM(c.input_tokens)+SUM(c.output_tokens) DESC, c.model, c.provider
